verse.verse_2: Because there came Unto him a blind man.
verse.verse_3: How canst thou know, whether haply he might be cleansed,
verse.verse_4: Or be admonished, so that the admonition might have profited him?
verse.verse_5: As for him who regardeth himself self-sufficient-
verse.verse_7: Whereas it is not on thee that he is not cleansed.
verse.verse_8: And as for him who cometh Unto thee running,
verse.verse_11: By no means! Verily it is an admonition.
verse.verse_12: So whosoever willeth-let him be admonished therewlth.
verse.verse_17: Perish man! how ungrateful he is!
verse.verse_18: Of what thing hath He created him?
verse.verse_19: Of a drop of seed. He created him and formed him according to a measure.
verse.verse_20: Then the way He made easy.
verse.verse_21: Then He caused him to die and made him to be buried.
verse.verse_22: Then when He listeth, He shall raise him to life.
verse.verse_23: By no means He performed not that which He had commanded him.
verse.verse_24: Let man look at his food:
verse.verse_25: It is We Who pour forth water, pouring,
verse.verse_26: Thereafter We cleave the earth in clefts,
verse.verse_27: Then We cause therein the grain to grow,
verse.verse_32: A provision for you and for your cattle.
verse.verse_33: Then when cometh the Deafening Cry-
verse.verse_34: On the Day whereon a man shall flee from his brother,
verse.verse_35: And his mother and his father,
verse.verse_36: And his wife and his sons;
verse.verse_37: For every one of them on that Day shall be business enough to occupy
verse.verse_38: Faces on that Day shall be beaming,
verse.verse_40: And faces on that Day! upon them shall be gloom.
verse.verse_42: Those! they are the infidels, the ungodly.
